name: Rammas Echor, Ancient Shield

abilities.text: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, draw a card, then create a 0/3 white Wall creature token with defender.
At the beginning of combat on your turn, creatures you control with defender gain exalted until end of turn.

notes: The second-spell trigger is the parser's own reading, kept verbatim. "creatures you control with defender gain exalted until end of turn" is not a targeted grant, so it is a for-each over the set (Filter.withKeyword 'defender', who 'you') with grant-keyword on the bound object — grant-keyword's group word 'creatures-you-control' carries no filter and would grant exalted to every creature.

issues: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, draw a card, then create a 0/3 white Wall creature token with defender. — expected a token named "Wall" (CR 111.4: a token's name is its subtype unless stated otherwise) — token effect should carry name: "Wall" alongside subtypes ["Wall"], as 25 of 44 token effects in the corpus do ("Eldrazi Scion", "Phyrexian Mite", "Treasure") — scripted token effect has power 0, toughness 3, colors ["W"], types ["Creature"], subtypes ["Wall"], keywords ["defender"] but NO name field; src/engine/game.ts:1379 then names it `${subtypes.join(' ')} token` = "Wall token". Confirmed by instrumented run: the created object's token.name is "Wall token", so the blind scenario's name-keyed assertions (pt [Wall,0,3], keywords [Wall,[defender]]) both report "no object named Wall". Everything else about the token (0/3, white, Wall, defender) and the draw-then-create ordering is correct. — CR 111.4

At the beginning of combat on your turn, creatures you control with defender gain exalted until end of turn. — expected NOT a script defect — recorded so the mechanical gate is not misread. The one-shot grant to the set of your defenders as the ability resolves is correctly encoded (for-each over {types [Creature], withKeyword defender, who you} + grant-keyword target 'that', duration eot), and an instrumented runScenario confirms Steel Wall and Wall of Wood end with eotKeywords ["exalted"] while Hill Giant does not. — scripted The two failing exalted scenarios (Grizzly Bears 2/2 instead of 4/4 / 3/3) fail in the harness, not the script: the scenario `attack` step routes through declareCombat -> Game.simulateCombat (src/verify/scenarioDsl.ts), and simulateCombat (src/engine/game.ts ~218-222) omits the lone-attacker exalted bonus that the real declare-attackers path applies at src/engine/game.ts:2406. Any card granting exalted would fail these scenarios identically. — CR 702.90a, 611.2c
